correctness.rationale: Complementation exchanges inclusion-minimal super domination with maximal open irredundance, which is hereditary and hence maximal iff all one-vertex additions fail. A flip affects only witness statuses within distance two, all decided in the radius-four window, with nonexistent neighbors excluded. The padded suffix transitions accept exactly those words; the restriction to n>=2 is necessary. I independently built the window truth table from induced graph neighbor intersections and verified exact shortest-distance inequalities for 233 states including the sink, 403 edges including 58 finalizations, and sink distance zero. Along any accepted word those inequalities give 7|T|-2n>=0. The seven explicit tails give the rounded bound exactly. For three or more blocks, an interior nine-window is one of seven phases, and any window touching a boundary or tail is determined by at most eight nearby periodic symbols and that fixed end. Thus the verified finite factor list exhausts the infinite construction. P1 has only the full super dominating set. Replay: `python /workspace/audit-replay.py 4`; the supplementary literal graph check covers n=2..11, not the infinite quantifier.
residual_risks: The all-length upper bound uses a finite computational certificate; it is not formal proof-assistant verification.
